O2.1.claim: The mechanism verdict is not calibrated against run-to-run variation, and B2f is an outlier on the same-source contrasts. The thresholds (-0.4*G = -0.34/-0.42/-0.38) and the clip-bootstrap CI cover only within-run noise. Unrelated retrains move these contrasts by 0.3-1.1 logit, in a direction set by B2f's position. Applying the proposal's full 'shown' rule (CI, clip DiD, half-B sign on both readouts) to 10 earlier runs with no NS/VAD/PLC exposure gives: NS 1 shown (failed B2a) and 7 refuted; VAD (i) 3 shown (B2e, B3b, B3e); PLC online 3 shown (B2c, B2d, B2e). A null opus_plc arm therefore has about a 1-in-3 chance of 'mechanism shown', and a real apm_ns effect at threshold would read about 0 (inconclusive or refuted). The verdict drives the section 5 combined-run recommendation and the apm_ns retry.
O2.1.required_change: In scripts/b4_dsp_slices.py and the signatures: (1) add --null_runs (B2b-B2e, B3a-B3e final readouts; B2a flagged or excluded) and print each contrast's null mean / SD / min; (2) re-centre: DiD* = DiD - null mean. 'Shown' = DiD* <= -0.4*G AND DiD below the panel minimum (or <= mean - 2 SD), with the clip and half-B conditions re-centred the same way. 'Refuted' = DiD* >= 0. (3) Pre-register a placebo-arm check: a lever's own-contrast DiD must be more negative than the other B4 arms' DiD on that contrast. (4) Restate the apm_ns / opus_plc thresholds and falsifier (1) on DiD*. dtx_gate (ii) can stay.

O2.2.claim: Two start-up selftest asserts can fail for legitimate NS behaviour and stop the arm at start-up. (a) The '-30 dBFS 1 kHz tone within +-3 dB at 6 dB' check uses a stationary tone, which a quantile noise estimator learns as noise. With priming on the clip's own first 0.5 s, attenuation up to the 6 dB floor is expected, while the intent ('no gain stage') is one-sided. (b) The '<100 Hz within 3 dB of 1-4 kHz' no-HPF check rests on two FFT bins (DC, 62.5 Hz) and is noisy on short excerpts.
O2.2.required_change: Make the gain check one-sided on a speech-like or AM input: output RMS <= input RMS + 0.5 dB at every level. Run the no-HPF check on >= 5 s of white noise after priming, averaged over frames, on 62.5-187.5 Hz (exclude DC). A failure must name the failing assert.
